explanation: The war that opened at Chai in September 1964 is what made FRELIMO the government of Mozambique. FRELIMO fought the Portuguese state for ten years. At Lusaka in 1974 Lisbon recognised it as the only party it would negotiate the transfer with, and no ballot established that. FRELIMO took the state whole at independence in June 1975. The election of 1977 is that state asking to be confirmed by a single list. The single list on the paper is the war's hold on the nationalist movement carried into government. That is also why the atlas can wire this ballot at all, where it retracted the colonial elections of the same country before 1974.
